intro.text: A Stoneward of the Fourth Ideal, famous among soldiers and Radiants alike for his prowess in battle.

items.text: Dami swore up to the Third Ideal of the Stonewards in the lead-up to the True Desolation. He fought in the Emuli offensive and swore his Fourth Ideal right afterwards, in a feat that impressed onlookers and made him famous. Dalinar named him in the line of succession for the throne of Urithiru.

Dami was flown to the Shattered Plains at a pivotal moment and helped push the enemy back and joined the coalition's leadership there. He defended the bridge during the retreat from Narak Four and helped Sigzil fight the Fused.
When a second Fused army arrived and Sigzil ordered a retreat, Dami resisted at first, disliking giving ground, but accepted it because Dalinar had made Sigzil his commanding officer.

appearance.text: Unusually tall in his golden Shardplate outlined in glowing orange, he stands a head taller than other Shardbearers. He prefers his Shardblade in the form of a tower shield.

personality.text: Fiercely loyal and resolute, he reveres Dalinar as a military genius and is unwilling to retreat, though he follows orders. He lives by the Stoneward creed, 'I will be there where I am needed', and is well liked.
